definitions.explanation: Done with great care and attention to detail, leaving nothing overlooked.

examples.japanese: {入念|にゅうねん}に{準備|じゅんび}した。
{入念|にゅうねん}な{調査|ちょうさ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{入念|にゅうねん}に{計画|けいかく}を{練|ね}り、{一|ひと}つも{見落|みお}としがないようにした。
examples.english: He carefully refined his plan, making sure not to overlook a single thing.

notes:
A な-adjective that emphasizes meticulous care and thoroughness. Used primarily as a modifier ({入念|にゅうねん}な + noun) or adverbially ({入念|にゅうねん}に + verb). Common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入念|にゅうねん}な{準備|じゅんび}: thorough preparation
- {入念|にゅうねん}な{調査|ちょうさ}: careful investigation
- {入念|にゅうねん}な{計画|けいかく}: meticulous plan
- {入念|にゅうねん}に{確認|かくにん}する: to check carefully
- {入念|にゅうねん}に{手入|てい}れする: to maintain carefully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {丁寧|ていねい}: polite, careful — broader, includes politeness in manner
- {慎重|しんちょう}: cautious, prudent — emphasizes avoiding mistakes or risk
- {念入|ねんい}り: thorough, careful — very close synonym, slightly more common in everyday speech
